activity.notes: Stephen Harper served continuously as Prime Minister of Canada from 6 February 2006 until the transfer of office to Justin Trudeau on 4 November 2015. House of Commons ministry tables sometimes list 3 November as the last full day of the 28th Ministry; the parliamentary roles record uses 4 November for the end of Harper's prime-ministerial role.

sources.title: Roles — Right Hon. Stephen Harper — House of Commons of Canada
sources.citation_text: The House of Commons records Harper's role as Prime Minister from 6 February 2006 to 4 November 2015.
